public.text: The definition says that the registry maintains a unique, verifiable identity record for every person accessing health services. In practice, records may be provisional, incomplete, duplicated, unmatched, or held at different assurance levels.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with wording that supports provisional registration, incomplete identity, uncertainty, multiple assurance levels, and later reconciliation without delaying essential care.
